results.note: Acta varia pertinentia ad epistolam C from Innocent III volume (PL 214). No English translation located despite multiple targeted searches. Appears to be miscellaneous acts/documents attached to a particular epistle.

Epistolae ad Innocentium III (Letters to Innocent III) from PL 217. Partial English translations exist: 'Selected Letters of Pope Innocent III Concerning England (1198-1216)' by Cheney & Semple (1953); Columbia University Epistolae database contains some translated letters. However, no complete English translation of the full epistolae collection appears to exist.

Dissertationes de historia Pelagiana from volume 48. These appear as supplementary dissertations alongside Marius Mercator's works on Pelagian and Nestorian heresies. Marius Mercator himself has no published complete English translation (only fragmentary AI-generated translations attempted). No English translation of the dissertations collection located.

Epigrammata from volume 87. Unable to determine specific authorship or full scope. Volume 87 contains works by various medieval authors (Gallus, Theodore, Maurus Ravennatensis, etc.) but specific information about epigrammatic works and their translations not located.

Supplementa ad testimonia from volume 144 (Peter Damian volume). Supplementary testimonies collection; no English translation located despite searches. Part of Damian's testimony materials in PL 144-145.

Testimonia de vita B. Petri Damiani from volume 144. Testimonies on the life of Blessed Peter Damian. John of Lodi's biography of Damian has selective English translations (P. McNulty, 1959; Fathers of the Church series), but a complete English translation of the testimonies collection itself was not located despite searches.
